{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the conversion fraction directly
conversion_fraction = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Print only the conversion fraction, as it is the only number needed for evidence
print(conversion_fraction)"}
